facts.text: The Bronco Promise provides full tuition for up to four years to incoming first-year Michigan residents whose family household adjusted gross income is $50,000 or less with net assets under $75,000.

sources.title: Scholarships | Empowering Futures | Western Michigan University
sources.quote: The Bronco Promise provides a tuition-free WMU education for up to four years for eligible first-year students. The University awards these incredible scholarships to hundreds of students annually.

sources.title: Scholarships | Empowering Futures | Western Michigan University
sources.quote: First-year student for fall entry in the year of admittance. Michigan resident, as defined by WMU's Residency Policy. Have a family household AGI of $50,000 or less and net assets under $75,000.
